intro.title: useTransition
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple search interface that updates a list of items based on user input. You'll learn how to use the React useTransition hook to manage state updates that should be treated as non-urgent, preventing the UI from becoming unresponsive during slow updates. The main technologies involved are React, JavaScript, and JSX, focusing on hooks and functional components. By the end, you'll understand how to keep your app responsive by marking certain updates as transitions.
intro.usecase: The useTransition hook is essential for creating smooth user experiences in data-heavy applications like dashboards and e-commerce sites. When users apply filters to large datasets or search through product catalogs, useTransition prevents the UI from freezing during data processing. This pattern is commonly seen in admin panels where sorting/filtering operations need to happen without blocking interactions, and in forms with complex validation that shouldn't disrupt typing. By marking non-urgent updates as transitions, developers maintain responsive interfaces even during computationally expensive operations.
